senses.gloss: f. (פָּרָה) increase; פ׳ ורביה (with ref. to פרו ורבו, Gen. I, 28) the duty of propagating the human race, the duty of marrying; marital duty.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 8b:11">M. Kat. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני ביטול פ׳ ור׳</he> because it might cause a diminution of marriages (as people might defer marriages for the festive season as most convenient).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:12">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>האיש מצווה על פ׳ ור׳ וכ׳</he> the duty of marrying has been put on man, but not on woman; Tanḥ. Noah 12.
<cite ref="Yevamot 62a:9">Yeb. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>קיים פ׳ ור׳</he> he has complied with the duty of propagation (and need not marry again).

<cite ref="Yevamot 62a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>דמעיקרא נמי בני פ׳ ור׳ נינהו</he> for they were subject to the duty of propagation before they became Jews (it being one of the Noachidian laws, <cite ref="Genesis 9:7">Gen. IX, 7</cite>); a. fr.
